record.name: Zinnia
record.appearance: adult woman, 31; long lavender ponytail with mint understrands, tan skin, pink eyes, holographic cropped jacket, glossy black and white cutout bustier, pink and cyan plaid microskirt, black thigh harnesses, mint diamond-mesh stocking, crystal-finned boots and a three-muzzle tricoil accelerator; floral hardware and phase-gel coolant remain technology, with no animal metamorph

passive.name: bloom charge
passive.description: Three consecutive primary hits on enemies charge the next manually cast damaging skill by 20%. A miss clears the unfinished streak, although its Bud remains useful. The charge is consumed on cast and does not multiply the same shot again when its stored lance later blooms.
passive.notes: Core rule (skill-paradigms.md): Buds. A missed primary plants one visible photonic Bud at its legal 11 m (1100 cm) endpoint. Buds last 6 s (180 ticks), maximum three; the oldest is replaced. One hostile primary hit destroys a Bud and its stored payload. Each holds at most one lance; its stored bearing is drawn on the ground. Expiring loaded Buds dissipate harmlessly. Stored or replayed shots cannot plant Buds or earn Bloom Charge. The charge is consumed on cast and does not multiply the same shot again when its stored lance later blooms. R5 extends one loaded Bud once to 8 s (240 ticks); it cannot stack multipliers, copy a payload or maintain a Bud forever. Passive forms carry rules, not a skill behaviour: the draft form behaviour was removed on promotion; it recorded rank 0 bloomCharge = "three consecutive primary hits on enemies charge the next manually cast damaging skill by 20%; a miss clears the unfinished streak (its Bud remains); consumed on cast" (schema cannot express a percentage bonus on the next manually cast damaging skill; three consecutive primary hits on enemies charge the next manually cast damaging skill by 20%; a miss clears the unfinished streak (its Bud remains); consumed on cast); rank 3 bloomCharge = "bank up to two charged casts; a miss resets the unfinished streak without erasing banked charges; one cast spends at most one charge" (schema cannot express a percentage bonus on the next manually cast damaging skill; bank up to two charged casts; a miss resets the unfinished streak without erasing banked charges; one cast spends at most one charge); rank 5 bloomCharge = "spend a banked charge to extend one loaded Bud to 8 s (240 ticks) and give its stored lance the single 20% bonus if not already applied; a Bud can be extended once" (schema cannot express a percentage bonus on the next manually cast damaging skill; spend a banked charge to extend one loaded Bud to 8 s (240 ticks) and give its stored lance the single 20% bonus if not already applied; a Bud can be extended once); rank 5 timing.duration = 240 (the extended Bud lives 8 s (240 ticks); the carrier is the extended Bud, one at a time.).

forms.name: save the blossom
forms.description: Bank up to two charged casts. Missing resets the unfinished streak without erasing banked charges. Choose whether to spend one when casting: prepare a trap with an ordinary lance and reserve the bonus for Prism Rain. One cast spends at most one charge.

forms.name: a shot that hasn't happened yet

A Bud can be extended once. She cannot stack multipliers, copy its payload or maintain it forever.

basic.name: petal bolt
basic.description: Fire an 88-damage photonic petal up to 11 m (1100 cm). It hits the first enemy, or plants a Bud on reaching a legal endpoint without hitting one. Deliberately missing a corridor is preparation, paid for with an attack and a broken Bloom streak.

dossier.identity: future artillery gardener operator who plants missed shots as photonic Buds and fires them later through delayed lances and prism rain
dossier.selectionRationale: The 2026-11-07 dossier proposals (docs/dossier-proposals/2026-11-07) make Zinnia an operator who keeps the supplied striker sheet's weapon and appearance: a missed shot becomes the barrel of a later, more important one, a delayed-artillery loop distinct from fable's sustain gardens and echo's tempo support.
dossier.weaponConcept: tricoil accelerator (triple-coil linear accelerator rifle with phase gel coolant; high-precision, high-velocity floral beam projection; recoil stabilizer, triple-coil magnets, gel coolant tank, targeting frame and phase battery)
dossier.loreStatus: draft lore composed from the supplied dossier sheet and the 2026-11-07 proposals; not owner-reviewed

lore.backstory: Zinnia tends a garden of unfinished shots. Every miss she plants becomes a bloom she can open later, and the phase-gel coolant in her accelerator is the only water the garden gets.
lore.syndicateRecord: Listed as an artillery contractor of the future-works trade; the supplied sheet records no affiliation and no charges.
lore.psychProfile: Playful and patient: she treats a wasted shot as preparation, and enjoys the moment a crossfire she laid out earlier finally closes.

t3.title: pruning shot
t3.effect: Aim into an owned Bud to move it up to 2 m (200 cm) along the shot's direction, remaining within 11 m (1100 cm) of Zinnia. Its payload and remaining timer move with it. This deals no damage and counts as neither a hit nor miss for the streak. A Bud cannot move through solid terrain.

t5.title: turn the flower
t5.effect: A pruning shot may rotate a loaded Bud's firing bearing toward the cursor instead of moving it. The new line warns for 0.65 s (19.5 ticks) before the Bud can bloom. Rotating spends the attack, refreshes no lifetime and cannot retarget an already resolving lance.

t3.title: grafted angle
t3.effect: Pierce three distinct enemies. At an empty Bud, choose to store the lance or consume the Bud to turn it once toward a second aimed point. Both segments share a 15 m (1500 cm) path budget and the original damage per victim. A bent segment gives its own 0.65 s (19.5 ticks) warning before firing.

t5.title: triple trellis
t5.effect: Fire three parallel/fanning lanes from the tricoil accelerator. Each can use a different Bud, creating a three-sided crossfire. A victim takes at most 180 total damage from that cast, before its one Bloom bonus, regardless of overlap. Bent lanes remain warned, range-limited and blocked by cover.

t3.title: cultivated weather
t3.effect: Increase the circle to 3 m (300 cm) radius. Choose the firing order of up to three loaded Buds inside; they bloom 0.4 s (12 ticks) apart, warning each line before release. Rain itself still hits once for 120. Her trap controls escape timing instead of producing simultaneous invisible beams.

t5.title: tomorrow, in three places
t5.effect: Place three separate 3 m (300 cm) radius circles, all within 15 m (1500 cm), resolving at 1.5 s (45 ticks), 2.3 s (69 ticks) and 3.1 s (93 ticks). Each deals its own 120 damage and blooms eligible Buds. A Bud belongs to the first resolving circle that captures it and fires only once. Move the storm along a retreat, or risk enemies escaping an overlapping pattern.

t3.title: save the blossom
t3.effect: Bank up to two charged casts. Missing resets the unfinished streak without erasing banked charges. Choose whether to spend one when casting: prepare a trap with an ordinary lance and reserve the bonus for Prism Rain. One cast spends at most one charge.

t5.title: a shot that hasn't happened yet
t5.effect: Instead of empowering a new cast, spend a banked charge to extend one loaded Bud's remaining life to 8 s (240 ticks) and give its stored lance the single 20% bonus if not already applied. A Bud can be extended once. She cannot stack multipliers, copy its payload or maintain it forever.

dossier.identity: future artillery gardener operator who plants missed shots as photonic Buds and fires them later through delayed lances and prism rain
dossier.selectionRationale: The 2026-11-07 dossier proposals (docs/dossier-proposals/2026-11-07) make Zinnia an operator who keeps the supplied striker sheet's weapon and appearance: a missed shot becomes the barrel of a later, more important one, a delayed-artillery loop distinct from fable's sustain gardens and echo's tempo support.
dossier.weaponConcept: tricoil accelerator (triple-coil linear accelerator rifle with phase gel coolant; high-precision, high-velocity floral beam projection; recoil stabilizer, triple-coil magnets, gel coolant tank, targeting frame and phase battery)
dossier.loreStatus: draft lore composed from the supplied dossier sheet and the 2026-11-07 proposals; not owner-reviewed

lore.backstory: Zinnia tends a garden of unfinished shots. Every miss she plants becomes a bloom she can open later, and the phase-gel coolant in her accelerator is the only water the garden gets.
lore.syndicateRecord: Listed as an artillery contractor of the future-works trade; the supplied sheet records no affiliation and no charges.
lore.psychProfile: Playful and patient: she treats a wasted shot as preparation, and enjoys the moment a crossfire she laid out earlier finally closes.

iconFamily.subject: a bold zinnia bloom with a single chunky aurora beam
iconFamily.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: one base raster concept for a game ability icon, to be traced into SVG. Character: Zinnia. Theme: aurora. Subject: a bold zinnia bloom with a single chunky aurora beam. Centered compact square silhouette, fills 82% of canvas. Flat solid black monochromatic ink on genuinely transparent background. Exceptionally bold clean outer contour, broad shapes and large negative-space gaps. Recognizable at 24 to 30 pixels. No tiny details, thin lines, text, badges, borders, HUD elements, colored accents, gradients, shadows, textures or 3D. ONE original base emblem, not a sheet or variants. All four subsequent ability variations must keep this same identifiable theme.
iconFamily.method: built-in image generation, then silhouette tracing, then four SVG variations
